newsitem.title: ITALY: FORECAST - Italy seen issuing 8.5 trln lire BTP, CCT.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Italy seen issuing 8.5 trln lire BTP, CCT.

text.p: The Italian Treasury is expected to issue on average 8.5 trillion lire worth of medium and long term paper at its mid-month auctions, a Reuter poll of analysts showed. The range forecast was between 6.5 and 10 trillion.
"The issue will be fairly substantial because on September 19 some 7.5 trillion lire of certificates with attached option (CTO) fall due," one analyst said.

On September 16 the Treasury will offer an 11th tranche of July 1 2006 fixed rate notes (BTP) and a new tranche of September 1 2003 floating rate notes (CCT) with a first coupon of 4.55 percent. Analysts see the Treasury issuing some 3.0 trillion lire of CCT and 1.5 trillion lire of 10 year BTPs.
On September 17, the Treasury will offer an 11th tranche of July 1 2001 BTPs and July 1 1999 BTPs. Analysts see the Treasury offering 2.0 trillion lire for both these maturities.
